name: Oakhurst Joinery
description: Bespoke windows, doors and staircases maker in the fictional town of Penmorrow.

items.title: Workshop open day
items.content: Oakhurst holds a workshop open day on 2026-12-05 from 10:40 to 15:20 at its Coopers Lane site, with free demonstrations. Notice OJ-PLN-0707.

items.title: Lead times
items.content: Sash windows take about 9 weeks and staircases 13 weeks from survey. Guide OJ-LT-913.

items.title: Workshop machine rules
items.content: Only trained staff use the spindle moulder SM-2; blade changes are logged in book OJ-SM-2 and checked by Ivor Lloyd.

items.title: Fitting team schedule
items.content: Fitting teams leave at 07:25 and must be on site by 08:30; travel over 47 miles earns an allowance. Schedule OJ-FIT-47.

items.title: Timber stock levels
items.content: Yard stock on 2026-10-01: 18.6 cubic metres of oak and 9.2 of sapele, supplied by Hartwood Timber. Sheet OJ-STK-1001.

items.title: Staircase collapse claim
items.content: A staircase we fitted at 4 Mill Row partly collapsed on 2026-09-19; the owner claims $38,700 and our expert blames a missing bolt. File OJ-CLM-0919-M.
